steps.title1: From raw content to a published post,
steps.lead: KLIP brings together all your social post-production: import your footage, compose your visuals, let AI write, schedule. For every client, without ever leaving the tool.
steps.s1d: Drop in a client’s photos and videos — all your material gathered in one place.
steps.s2d: Create your visuals or rework your imports in the built-in editor, Canva-style. The client’s brand kit is already applied.
steps.s3d: Captions, descriptions and hashtags generated from the image and the client’s brand voice.
steps.s4d: Slot it on the calendar, get it approved, KLIP publishes to Instagram — for each of your clients.

showcase.lead: Visual editor, editorial calendar, publishing queue, video editing: the tools you open every day in KLIP.
showcase.editorTitle: Each client’s brand kit, applied in one click
showcase.editorText: Select some text and it all opens up — font, size, brand colors, effects, animations. The same power as Canva or the Adobe suite, already set to your client.
showcase.calDesc: Every post from every client on a single grid. Drag to reschedule, spot the gaps, keep the rhythm — no spreadsheet.
showcase.queueDesc: Your Instagram accounts connected. You approve, KLIP publishes at the scheduled slot — no need to reopen the app or post by hand.
showcase.montageDesc: A built-in CapCut-style video editor: multi-track timeline, cutting, automatic captions, one-click assembly. Your Reels are edited right here — no export, no extra subscription.
showcase.montDesc: Cut, subtitle and dress up your Reels in the built-in video editor. AI-generated subtitles, overlays, ready-to-publish export.

features.title1: What used to take ten tools,
features.mainText: Each client’s brand kit — colors, type, logo — applied in one click. You drag the text, it’s pixel-perfect. No design software to open anymore.
features.f1d: Tone, style, banned words. Every generation respects the client’s DNA.
features.f2d: Captions and hashtags generated from the photo and the brand’s context.
features.f3d: Brand kit, history, connected accounts — siloed, never mixed.
features.f4d: Connect a pro account. Schedule, approve, KLIP publishes at the slot.
features.fMontageD: Cutting, automatic captions, one-click assembly. A CapCut-style editor, right inside KLIP.
features.f5d: Reels cut, AI-subtitled and exported — without leaving KLIP.

faq.q1: Do I need to already have a pro Instagram account?
faq.a1: Yes. KLIP connects to a professional or creator Instagram account via the official API. Connecting takes two minutes, per client.
faq.q2: Does the AI really respect each brand’s voice?
faq.a2: You define the tone, style and banned words for each client once. Every generation draws on that voice — you stay in control and refine in one click.
faq.q3: Can my clients approve without a KLIP account?
faq.a3: Yes. You send an approval link: the client approves or comments directly, with nothing to install. No more email back-and-forth.
faq.a4: Each client has its own space: brand kit, history, connected accounts. Nothing is ever mixed between two brands.
faq.q5: Can I change plans along the way?
faq.a5: Anytime, no commitment. You move up a tier when you take on more clients, and back down if needed.
faq.aMontage: Yes, in every plan. The built-in video editor — CapCut-style — handles cutting, automatic captions and one-click assembly. No extra software or subscription.

legalPrivacy.metaDescription: How Klip collects, uses and protects your personal data.
legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
legalPrivacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how <b1>Klip</b1> ("we", "us", "our") — operated by Martin Koch, micro-entreprise SIREN 931920821 — collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use our service at <b2>getklip.fr</b2>. By using Klip, you agree to the practices described below.
legalPrivacy.sub1Text: When you create an account we collect your <b1>name</b1>, <b2>email address</b2>, and a <b3>hashed password</b3> (never stored in plain text).
legalPrivacy.sub2Text: For each client workspace you create we store the <b1>client name</b1>, <b2>brand colours</b2>, <b3>typography settings</b3>, and any <b4>brand assets you upload</b4> (logos, fonts, images).
legalPrivacy.sub3Text: When you connect an Instagram account via OAuth we store the account's username, Instagram account ID, and an OAuth access token. This token is stored securely on our servers and is never exposed in the browser or sent to third parties other than Meta's API.
legalPrivacy.sub4Text: We store the <b1>posts you create</b1> inside Klip, including uploaded visuals, AI-generated descriptions, scheduled dates, and publication status.
legalPrivacy.use1: Provide, operate and improve the Klip service
legalPrivacy.use2: Publish content to Instagram on your behalf, strictly when you initiate the action and have granted explicit OAuth permission
legalPrivacy.use3: Generate AI captions and visual copy based on your visuals and brand settings
legalPrivacy.use4: Contact you for account-related communications and support
legalPrivacy.section2Outro: We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or any purpose beyond delivering the service you signed up for.
legalPrivacy.section3Text1: We never sell your data to third parties. Data is shared only with the following sub-processors, strictly to operate the service:
legalPrivacy.section3Text2: Each sub-processor is bound by its own privacy policy and applicable data protection regulations.
legalPrivacy.ig1: Klip accesses your Instagram account exclusively through Meta's official OAuth flow — we never ask for your Instagram password.
legalPrivacy.ig3: These permissions are used solely to display your account stats and publish posts you have approved inside Klip.
legalPrivacy.ig4: You can revoke access at any time from your Instagram account settings under Apps & Websites.
legalPrivacy.ig5: OAuth access tokens are stored securely in our database and are never exposed client-side or included in API responses to the browser.
legalPrivacy.ig6Pre: To request immediate deletion of your Instagram data:
legalPrivacy.ret1: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active.
legalPrivacy.ret2: If you delete your account, all personal data and associated content will be permanently deleted within 30 days.
legalPrivacy.ret3: Backup copies may persist for up to 30 additional days before being purged from all systems.
legalPrivacy.rightsIntro: If you are located in the European Economic Area you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
legalPrivacy.right1: Right of access — obtain a copy of the data we hold about you
legalPrivacy.right2: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
legalPrivacy.right3: Right to erasure — request deletion of your personal data
legalPrivacy.right4: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
legalPrivacy.right5: Right to object — object to processing based on legitimate interests
legalPrivacy.right6: Right to restriction — request that we restrict processing of your data
legalPrivacy.rightsText1Pre: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at
legalPrivacy.sec1: All data is transmitted over HTTPS / TLS
legalPrivacy.sec2: Instagram access tokens are stored securely in the database and are never sent to the browser
legalPrivacy.sec3: Row Level Security (RLS) is enforced on all database tables — each user can only access their own data
legalPrivacy.sec4: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt via Supabase Auth — we never see your plain-text password
legalPrivacy.sec5: File storage buckets are access-controlled by authenticated user ID
legalPrivacy.secOutro: Despite our efforts, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. If you discover a security vulnerability please report it to
legalPrivacy.footer: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
